import statistics

def remove_outliers(xs, k):
    if not xs:
        return []
    mean = statistics.mean(xs)
    stdev = statistics.stdev(xs, xbar=mean) if len(xs) > 1 else 0
    threshold = k * stdev
    return [x for x in xs if abs(x - mean) <= threshold]
